Reflection logic and type lookup for bincode serializers.

# Purpose
`fd_types_reflect.h` defines the reflection interface for bincode type serializers. It declares the `fd_types_vt_t` virtual table, which stores type metadata such as the type name, alignment, hash, and function pointers for allocation, decode, encode, size, and tree walk operations. The file also declares `fd_types_vt_list`, a null-terminated table of supported type serializers, and [`fd_types_vt_by_name`](<#fd_types_vt_by_name>), which returns a type descriptor from a name and name length.
